dialog.title: New project
dialog.client_hint: Type the name: your clients show up to choose from. A new name is added to your clients.
dialog.client_new: A new client: added to your clients when you save.
dialog.template_hint: Its usual steps become the project's tasks, due from the start day.

people.title: People
people.none: Nobody here works on projects yet. Give people the projects role first.
people.hint: Tick everyone who works on it; the star marks who leads it (optional).
people.saved: People saved: those added are told.
people.nobody: Nobody is on this task yet.

notes.title: Notes
notes.placeholder: Write a note for the others on it…

list.title: Projects
list.text: Your projects for clients, with their tasks and who works on them.
list.group_reads: You see every company's projects here. To open or change one, switch to its company or branch.
list.search: Search by name, number or client
list.none_text: No project fits this search or status. Clear it to see all.
list.empty_text: Open your first project for a client; a template adds its usual tasks.

mine.title: My tasks
mine.text: Every task you are on, in projects under way: overdue first.
mine.empty_text: Tasks given to you show here.

board.title: Tasks
board.empty: No tasks yet. Add the first one, or open projects from a template next time.

steps.hold_text: Say why: it shows on the project. Tasks can still be changed.
steps.finish_text: Its tasks can no longer change (reopen it if needed). Tasks not done stay as they are.
steps.cancel_text: Nothing is deleted. Say why: it shows on the project.
steps.reopen_text: The project becomes active again. Say why.

templates.title: Templates
templates.text: The usual steps of a kind of work. Opening a project from a template adds them as tasks.
templates.empty_text: Write down the usual steps once (e.g. a BSCI audit) and open projects from them.
templates.name: Template name
templates.service_hint: Optional: given to projects opened from it.
